units.source_text: 然而，一旦要拆除，又不免使人有几分留恋。

en.t: Yet once it came time to remove it, people could not help feeling somewhat reluctant to part with it.

units.source_text: 也许由于这个缘故，人们用假花把电车装饰成“花电车”，

en.t: Perhaps for that reason, people decorated the streetcar with artificial flowers and turned it into a "flower streetcar,"

units.source_text: 然后让一些按明治年代风俗打扮起来的人乘上，

en.t: then had several people dressed in Meiji-era styles ride on it,

units.source_text: 借此广泛地向市民们宣告。

en.t: and in this way made a broad announcement to the townspeople.
This too was probably a kind of "ceremony."
